Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; }
  body {
    background: #090605;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100dvh;
    touch-action: none;
    overscroll-behavior: none;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100dvh;
    /* Warmth breathes very slowly; disabled below for reduced motion. */
    animation: warmth 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes warmth {
    from { filter: brightness(1) saturate(1); }
    to   { filter: brightness(1.045) saturate(1.06); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    canvas { animation: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen with noodles, tofu, mushrooms, greens and corn, served in a dark ceramic bowl in warm, dim light."></canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ setup */
const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const reducedMQ = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, S = 0;          // viewport, pixel ratio, scene scale
let rafId = 0, running = false, lastNow = 0, t = 0;

/* Deterministic randomness, so the topping layout is stable between frames. */
function mulberry32(seed) {
  return function () {
    seed |= 0; seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let z = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    z ^= z + Math.imul(z ^ (z >>> 7), 61 | z);
    return ((z ^ (z >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
const rand = mulberry32(20261013);
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
const lerp = (a, b, k) => a + (b - a) * k;

/* ------------------------------------------------------- pre-placed garnish
   Positions are normalised to the broth ellipse (-1..1 on each axis). */
function inBroth(x, y, margin) { return (x * x + y * y) < (1 - margin) * (1 - margin); }

const oilDrops = [], corn = [], scallions = [], sesame = [], chiliDrops = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
  const a = rand() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.86;
  oilDrops.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, s: 0.012 + rand() * 0.03, p: rand() * TAU });
}
for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {           // corn, gathered toward the front-right
  const x = 0.08 + (rand() - 0.35) * 0.75, y = 0.18 + (rand() - 0.4) * 0.55;
  if (inBroth(x, y, 0.14)) corn.push({ x, y, s: 0.02 + rand() * 0.014, p: rand() * TAU, rot: rand() * TAU });
}
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {           // scallion rings, scattered
  const a = rand() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.82;
  scallions.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, s: 0.016 + rand() * 0.016, p: rand() * TAU });
}
for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
  const a = rand() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.85;
  sesame.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, s: 0.008 + rand() * 0.006, rot: rand() * TAU, p: rand() * TAU });
}
for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {           // chilli oil
  const a = rand() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.8;
  chiliDrops.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, s: 0.014 + rand() * 0.026, p: rand() * TAU });
}

/* Larger toppings, hand-placed so the bowl reads as composed, not random. */
const tofu = [
  { x: -0.42, y: 0.22, s: 0.17, rot: -0.35, p: 0.4 },
  { x: -0.22, y: 0.38, s: 0.15, rot: 0.5,  p: 2.1 },
  { x: -0.52, y: 0.02, s: 0.14, rot: 0.2,  p: 4.0 }
];
const mushrooms = [
  { x: 0.48, y: -0.18, s: 0.2,  rot: 0.4,  p: 1.2 },
  { x: 0.62, y: 0.05,  s: 0.16, rot: -0.7, p: 3.3 },
  { x: 0.3,  y: -0.36, s: 0.15, rot: 1.1,  p: 5.1 }
];
const greens = [                          // bok choy leaves
  { x: -0.18, y: -0.34, s: 0.34, rot: -0.5, p: 0.9 },
  { x: 0.02,  y: -0.46, s: 0.3,  rot: 0.35, p: 2.8 },
  { x: -0.62, y: -0.28, s: 0.26, rot: -1.1, p: 4.6 }
];
const carrots = [];                       // fine julienne, front-left
for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
  carrots.push({ x: -0.08 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.3, y: 0.42 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.18, len: 0.14 + rand() * 0.14, rot: -0.5 + rand() * 1.0, p: rand() * TAU });
}
const noodleNests = [];                   // wavy strands resting in the broth
for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
  noodleNests.push({ x: (rand() - 0.5) * 0.9, y: (rand() - 0.35) * 0.8, s: 0.22 + rand() * 0.2, rot: rand() * TAU, p: rand() * TAU });
}
const dust = [];                          // warm motes in the air
for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
  dust.push({ x: rand(), y: rand(), s: 0.0008 + rand() * 0.0022, p: rand() * TAU, v: 0.4 + rand() * 0.8 });
}
const speckles = [];                      // ceramic speckle on the bowl
for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
  speckles.push({ x: (rand() - 0.5) * 1.7, y: 0.12 + rand() * 0.68, s: 0.004 + rand() * 0.009, a: 0.05 + rand() * 0.16 });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- live state */
const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0, nx: 0, ny: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0, lastX: 0, lastY: 0, seen: false };
let wind = 0;            // horizontal air current, fed by pointer movement
let heat = 0;            // 0..1, rises while the pointer hovers near the bowl
let swirl = 0, swirlVel = 0.018;   // slow broth rotation
let bounce = 0;          // toppings bob harder for a moment after a tap
let rippleTimer = 1.6, stirCooldown = 0;
const steam = [], ripples = [];

/* Soft round sprite for steam and glows, drawn once and reused. */
const puff = document.createElement('canvas');
puff.width = puff.height = 128;
{
  const p = puff.getContext('2d');
  const g = p.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 2, 64, 64, 64);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,244,228,0.85)');
  g.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(250,232,208,0.38)');
  g.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(240,220,192,0.12)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240,220,192,0)');
  p.fillStyle = g; p.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
}
/* Faint static grain, tiled as a pattern. */
const grainTile = document.createElement('canvas');
grainTile.width = grainTile.height = 140;
{
  const p = grainTile.getContext('2d');
  const img = p.createImageData(140, 140);
  const gr = mulberry32(77);
  for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
    const v = 200 + Math.floor(gr() * 55);
    img.data[i] = v; img.data[i + 1] = v; img.data[i + 2] = v;
    img.data[i + 3] = gr() > 0.5 ? 14 : 0;
  }
  p.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
}

Done — [index.html](/app/index.html) is a standalone, zero-asset scene that you can open directly in a browser.

It renders one steaming vegan ramen bowl in code on a full-screen canvas: a dark glazed bowl in warm lantern light, miso broth with swirling oil glints and chilli oil, noodles lifted on chopsticks, tofu, shiitake, bok choy, nori, corn, scallions, carrot, and sesame. Steam curls continuously, toppings bob, and the broth ripples on its own. Moving the mouse adds gentle parallax, pushes steam aside, and stirs the broth over the bowl; hovering makes it steam harder, and a click or tap sends out a ripple with a burst of steam. There is no visible text, UI, or menu, the layout scales to any screen and pixel density, and `prefers-reduced-motion` yields a single still frame with no parallax or animation.

Validation passed: no external, network, or raster references were found, the body contains only the canvas, and the file served with HTTP 200. No browser or JavaScript runtime is installed in this environment, so live in-browser rendering remains unverified.
Muse's native export reports 11 history gaps and 11 omitted live-only records. Missing content has not been reconstructed.
